About the Tuesday Night Easy Ride group ride

A beginner road ride out Fort Hall Mine Road and back, about 17 miles. Someone on the ride will help with seat height, shifting, flats and posture. No-drop and paced to whoever shows up. I.C.E. membership is $10 and can be bought at the shop before the ride. The same club and shop run a Thursday night no-drop ride for all levels.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
